SELECT pt.trip_id tripId, pt.start_time startTime, pt.end_time endTime, pt.approval_status approvalStatus, pt.create_time createTime, pt.community_id communityId, pc.key_cabinet keyCabinet, uu.`name` applicant, uo.org_name department FROM pubcar_trip pt LEFT JOIN pubcar_trip_car_num ptcn ON ptcn.trip_id = pt.trip_id AND ptcn.status_cd = '0' LEFT JOIN pubcar_car pc ON pc.car_id = ptcn.car_id AND pc.status_cd = '0' LEFT JOIN u_user uu ON uu.user_id = pt.user_id AND uu.status_cd = '0' LEFT JOIN u_org_staff_rel uosr ON uosr.staff_id = uu.user_id AND uosr.status_cd = '0' LEFT JOIN u_org uo ON uo.org_id = uosr.org_id AND uo.status_cd = '0' WHERE pt.trip_id IN
#{item}

SELECT trip_id tripId, DATE_FORMAT(start_time, '%Y年%c月%e日') startDate, `start`, destination FROM pubcar_trip WHERE community_id = #{communityId} AND status_cd = '0' AND trip_status = 3 ORDER BY create_time DESC
limit #{page}, #{row}
SELECT COUNT(1) count FROM pubcar_trip WHERE community_id = #{communityId} AND status_cd = '0' AND trip_status = 3

SELECT t.trip_id tripId, n.trip_type tripType, IFNULL(SUM(m.avgMileage), 0) tripMileage FROM pubcar_trip t LEFT JOIN pubcar_trip_car_num n ON n.trip_id = t.trip_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT trip_id, AVG(pass_mileage) avgMileage FROM pubcar_trip_mileage GROUP BY trip_id ) m ON m.trip_id = n.trip_id WHERE t.status_cd = '0'
AND DATE(t.start_time) = CURRENT_DATE() + 1
AND DATEDIFF(DATE(t.start_time), CURRENT_DATE()) >= 0 AND DATEDIFF(DATE(t.start_time), CURRENT_DATE()) <= 7
SELECT trip_id tripId, trip_status tripStatus, approval_status approvalStatus FROM pubcar_trip WHERE status_cd = '0' AND DATE(start_time) = CURRENT_DATE()
mapper.insert: insert into business_pubcar_trip(b_id, trip_id, user_id, car_type, car_type_detail, `start`, destination, mileage, start_time, end_time,apply_num, trip_status, approval_status, is_bureau_leader_approve, is_depart_leader_approve, remark, apply_reason, is_urgent, is_daily, daily_period, operate, community_id) values (#{bId}, #{tripId}, #{userId}, #{carType}, #{carTypeDetail}, #{start}, #{destination}, #{mileage}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{applyNum}, #{tripStatus}, #{approvalStatus}, #{isBureauLeaderApprove}, #{isDepartLeaderApprove}, #{remark}, #{applyReason}, #{isUrgent}, #{isDaily}, #{dailyPeriod}, #{operate}, #{communityId})

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.trip_id) count FROM pubcar_trip t LEFT JOIN pubcar_trip_car_num n ON n.trip_id = t.trip_id LEFT JOIN pubcar_trip_car_passenger p ON p.num_id = n.num_id WHERE t.status_cd= '0'
and (p.user_id = #{driverId} or t.user_id = #{driverId})
and (t.trip_status = 1 or t.trip_status = 2)
and t.trip_status = 3
